# List of adult animated feature films nominated for Academy Awards

This page highlights the animated feature films targeted for young adult and mature audiences nominated for or won Academy Awards. Some of the first adult animated films to be nominated in each categories:
PG-13
* The Triplets of Belleville (2003) is the first PG-13 rated to be nominated for Best Animated Feature and Original Song.
* Isle of Dogs (2018) is the first PG-13 rated to be nominated for Best Original Score.
* Flee (2021) was nominated for the Best Documentary Feature category for the first time.
* The Boy and the Heron (2023) is rated PG-13 by the MPA, won Best Animated Feature for the first time.
R
* South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut (1999) is rated R by the MPA, the first R-rated to be nominated for Best Original Song.
* Waltz with Bashir (2008) is rated R by the MPA, the first to be nominated for Best International Feature Film.
* Anomalisa (2015) is the first R-rated to be nominated for the Best Animated Feature category.
Films like Chico and Rita and I Lost My Body were not officially rated by the MPA in the United States but due to their respective mature themes, it was eventually rated TV-14 or TV-MA in television and streaming releases.
